versions.subject: Rule to detect the execution of a script via SCX RunAsprovider ExecuteScript
versions.detection:
selection:
    type: 'SYSCALL'
    SYSCALL: 'execve'
    uid: '0'
    cwd: '/var/opt/microsoft/scx/tmp'
    cmdline|contains: /etc/opt/microsoft/scx/conf/tmpdir/scx
    comm: 'sh'
condition: selection
